title: Susan Gough says Gimbal is not a training video
summary: Mick West tells of Susan Gough says Gimbal is not a training video, about 2015 video at off Florida, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I asked Susan Goant and she told me it wasn't a training video.

plain: Mick West, a skeptic who studies UFO videos, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he asked Susan Gough, a Pentagon spokesperson, about the Gimbal video, a 2015 clip filmed by a Navy jet's camera off Florida that shows a strange object turning in the sky. West says she told him it was not a training video. That matters because it means the clip is treated as real footage of a real event, whatever the object turns out to be.
